key_line.metric: FY2026 guide and the Q4 it implies
key_line.detail: Guide raised to +7-9% cc (from +5-7%), adj op margin 27-28% (from 25-26%), adj EBITDA $1.575-1.625bn (from $1.45-1.50bn). Q3 includes about $55M of tariff refunds ($48M Consumer Products, $7M Wizards); the release does not say whether the outlook includes refunds. Nine-month revenue $3,735.1M (2025: $3,255.4M). Own arithmetic on the hunt's FY2025 base of about $4.70bn: the raised range is about $5.03-5.12bn, so implied Q4 revenue is about $1.29-1.39bn against about $1.44bn a year ago, Q4 down roughly 4-10% y/y. The 2-point raise (about $95M) is smaller than the Q3 revenue beat over consensus (about $125M). Arithmetic on cc guidance vs reported revenue, not a company figure.

guidance.detail: Revenue +7-9% cc (was +5-7%), adj op margin 27-28% (was 25-26%), adj EBITDA $1.575-1.625bn (was $1.45-1.50bn); buyback target doubled (amounts not given). The raise is below the Q3 beat, so the implied Q4 is weaker than a year ago; CEO says 'strong finish to 2026 and continued growth in 2027'.

call.detail: Call began 08:30 ET and very likely runs into the open; no transcript or call coverage was found by about 09:05 ET. The questions that matter are Q4 phasing (Magic timing into Q1 2027) and whether the $55M tariff refund repeats. The pre-market faded from 103.00 to 98.59 while the call was starting.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions, wire stories or retail posts about the Q3 2026 release were indexed by about 09:05 ET; searches returned only the Q2 2026 (July) and Q3 2025 coverage. Headline itself is a clear beat and raise, so sell-side target raises are likely to land during the session; the counter is the implied Q4 decline and the one-off tariff refunds.

tape_read.note: Pre-market range 97.38 (-1.1%) to 103.00 (+4.6%) against prev close 98.49; last 98.59 (+0.1%) at 08:55, so the bar is fresh. A beat-and-raise headline that first traded up 4.6% then faded to flat says the market has read the implied Q4 and the one-off refunds. Far inside the 8.4% implied move and the 8.8% guide-driven reactions of May and July. Zero volume on the bars: a range of prices that existed, not size.

thesis_check.note: Consumer Products missed the Zacks $862M by about 4% and the raised guide still implies a lower Q4, which is the arithmetic the short rested on; but Wizards beat by roughly a quarter, EPS beat by more than half and the guide was raised rather than held, the outcome the short was betting against.

recommendation.limit_basis: The pre-market low (97.3801, -1.1% vs prev close), a level already traded this morning after the release; about 1.2% below the last pre-market print, roughly an eighth of the 8.4% implied move.
recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn sterk (omzet en winst ruim boven verwachting, jaarprognose verhoogd), maar de koers is voorbeurs teruggezakt van 103 naar vlak omdat de verhoogde prognose een zwakker vierde kwartaal inhoudt en de winst eenmalige tariefteruggaven bevat. De richting voor de rest van de dag is een gok, dus zet een order om de short terug te kopen op 97,38 (het voorbeurs-dieptepunt); wordt die niet geraakt, dan gaat de positie bij het slot.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 weer boven 101 staat of er koersdoelverhogingen van analisten verschijnen, sluit de short dan direct bij de opening.
